contract.hash_of: raw UTF-8 blob at the issuing commit

error_allocation: delta = alpha/8: two tails x two signs (positive/negative parts) x two contrasts, union bound; fixed even when data are 0/1 or a contrast looks uninteresting
threshold: c = log(1/delta) = log(8/alpha); endpoints of {q: n kl(x||q) <= c}; l_n(0)=0, u_n(0)=1-exp(-c/n), l_n(1)=exp(-c/n), u_n(1)=1
interval: I_j = [l_n(mean max(L_j,0)) - u_n(mean max(-L_j,0)), u_n(mean max(U_j,0)) - l_n(mean max(-U_j,0))], intersected with [-1,1]
shared_scores: consolidate each primitive id to one coefficient; L = sum_{c>=0} c*a + sum_{c<0} c*b, U = sum_{c>=0} c*b + sum_{c<0} c*a; checks bookkeeping only, not execution identity

numerical_policy.arithmetic: exact Fractions; Decimal conversion with floor/ceiling; outward interval arithmetic
numerical_policy.transcendentals: Decimal ln/exp correctly rounded (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), each enclosed by its adjacent representable values
numerical_policy.undecided: if an enclosure cannot decide a comparison, bisection stops and the current bracket is kept
numerical_policy.output: lower exterior endpoint for l, upper exterior endpoint for u; no added epsilon

no_data: n = 0 returns a labelled [-1, 1] without evaluating KL
assumptions_not_established_here: fixed n and equal family weights
valid deterministic pathwise bounds L <= D <= U for every planned family
consistent interventions, receiver/scorer stability, isolation, valid measurement
declared sampling law aligning the average-expectation target with a population
shared primitive identity under a predeclared branch-reuse law
not_covered: optional stopping, random completer denominators, outcome-chosen learners/splits/subgroups/endpoints
decision_rule_reference: useful gain g = .05: strict lower > .05 benefit, strict upper < .05 futility, else inconclusive (lead-owned; not implemented as a decision here)
